ModMetaData.author: karbonpanzer
ModMetaData.name: A Brave New Frontier II
ModMetaData.description:
A total rebuild of my previous mod, A Brave New Frontier.
The reason for this rebuild is that BNF over time had what I can best describe as "identity issues" with what it was.

A Brave New Frontier II adds:
Two new factions and a unique scenario.
A new tier of flak armor.
Combat focused accessories.
And "cost effective" weapon designs.

Additions which are gonna be noticed by people who played the previous version of the mod are:
Fixed textures masks.
Conversion from stuffed armor to fixed cost armor.
Removal of the decal system from BNF which was poorly made by me.
Entirely new weapons which fit the theme better.

Yes, this is all NCR looking, that is by design because this was inspired by Shazbot's Frontier Uniforms which is also NCR inspired.

Big thanks to Krazy4Games for the art and Shazbot for the inspiration.
